pages.title: Doors
pages.text: $(bold)DUTY LOG$()$(br)Deng, T., door maintenance$(br2)Why I am here: I keep doors moving. Thirty years of blast doors, and the pay cleared my brother's debts. They asked if I minded working alone. I said doors don't talk.

These do something. I greased the first one with my back to it, and it had moved when I looked round. I faced it for an hour: nothing.$(br2)There is no motor on the drawings. I have stopped putting that in the fault log. It comes back unsigned.
